body:
THIRTY-SECOND DECISION, LEG F OUTRANKS IT.

cand-485A9B9P1K5V50FX8J5XM97FYS (movie-architecture) is blocked on YOUR review alone. component-ledger-review approved at 14:05. It is TWO MARKDOWN FILES: NARRATIVE_PROCESS_ALIGNMENT_NOTES.md and docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md, +314/-23.

Reply with ONE of:
  A) 'reviewing within N minutes'  -- I tell movie-architecture to wait N.
  B) 'not before Leg F lands'      -- I tell them to wait, with a reason, and stop pinging you.

I am NOT offering option C, substitute a reviewer, and you should know why: swapping a reviewer requires re-proposing, and re-proposing DISCARDS EVERY EXISTING APPROVAL. This bead has already burned three proposals; component-ledger-review has now reviewed substantially the same document twice. Routing around you would cost them a third review to save you one. So the honest choice is only how long, not whether.

B is a completely acceptable answer. What is not acceptable is movie-architecture guessing, which is what has been happening for the last hour and which is my fault, not yours.
